purpose: Verify lawful official public intake routes for Wave 2 and Wave 3 high-priority marketplace targets without sending outreach or changing external evidence gates.

targets.route_evidence: Airbus' official supplier-network page directs prospective suppliers to send company information to globalsourcing@airbus.com, after which Airbus may assess fit and initiate deeper qualification.
targets.fit_note: Strong future supplier route. No company information, NDA request, assessment submission or tender participation occurs before contact authorization.

targets.route_type: official contact page with Partners routing
targets.route_evidence: Serve Robotics' official Contact Us page includes a Partners inquiry category.
targets.fit_note: Official partnership path verified; no form or message is submitted.

targets.public_contact: Official corporate and business-unit contact paths
targets.route_evidence: Pioneer Power Solutions' official contact page lists its corporate office and business-specific contact paths for Pioneer Critical Power, Power Mobility and CEP.
targets.fit_note: Official route verified; future use should select the business unit matching a bounded evidence pilot after authorization.

targets.route_type: official supplier/vendor onboarding and supplier-quality contact
targets.route_evidence: VSE Aviation maintains an official New Vendor Setup process and a Manufacturing Suppliers page directing non-approved suppliers to SupplierQuality@vseviation.com.
targets.fit_note: Strong supplier route fit. No vendor form, banking data, W-9, certification file or supplier communication is submitted before authorization.

targets.route_evidence: BOXABL's official Contact page provides a categorized inquiry form and public company contact channels.
targets.fit_note: Official but broad route; a partnership/vendor-specific option should be re-verified before any future use.

targets.public_contact: Official partner-program and corporate contact paths
targets.route_evidence: Adtran's official site describes its global partner ecosystem, including technology partners, and provides a corporate contact form.
targets.fit_note: Strong future partnership route; no partner-program application or message is submitted.

targets.route_evidence: Supermicro's official contact page lists separate U.S. commercial and government sales inquiry channels.
targets.fit_note: Official route verified; supplier/partner specificity should be rechecked before any future use.

targets.public_contact: Official 'Become a Cyngn Partner' enrollment path
targets.route_evidence: Cyngn's official Dealer Network page explicitly offers a Partner Program and a 'Become a Cyngn Partner' path.
targets.fit_note: Strong partnership route fit, but no enrollment or contact is performed before authorization.

claims_boundary: Route verification establishes only that an official public channel exists. It does not establish target interest, supplier or partner qualification, procurement eligibility, remediation probability, permission to submit sensitive material, or authorization under the Worldshepherd 98.7 contact policy to use the route.
